sqlMap.select:
SELECT T.FIELD_ID, T.TABLE_ID, T.CODE_TYPE,
get_global_name(T.FIELD_NAME, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) FIELD_NAME, T.SHOT_TABLE FROM INFO_FIELD T
WHERE T.TABLE_ID=#TABLE_ID:VARCHAR# ORDER BY T.ORDERNO
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO HR_RETRIEVE_STORED( HR_RETRIEVE_STORED_NO, PERSON_ID, CPNY_ID, RETRIEVE_TABLE_NO, CONDSQL, SQLKEY, COLNAME, CONDSQLCNT, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES( HR_RETRIEVE_STORED_seq.Nextval, #PERSON_ID#, #CPNY_ID#, #RETRIEVE_TABLE_NO#, #CONDSQL#, #SQLKEY#, #COLNAME#, #CONDSQLCNT#, #CREATED_BY#, SYSDATE )
sqlMap.select: SELECT T.HR_RETRIEVE_STORED_NO AS TABLE_NO , get_global_name(T.RETRIEVE_TABLE_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AS TABLE_NAME FROM HR_RETRIEVE_STORED T WHERE T.PERSON_ID=#PERSON_ID# AND T.CPNY_ID=#CPNY_ID#

SELECT SP.CODE_NO, T.DESCRIPTION, T.DEPTH, T.ORDERNO, T.PARENT_CODE_NO, S1.CONTENT CODE_NAME FROM SY_CODE T, SY_CODE_PARAM SP, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S1 WHERE T.PARENT_CODE_NO = #PARENT_CODE_NO# AND T.CODE_NO = SP.CODE_NO AND SP.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID# AND T.CODE_NO = S1.NO(+) AND S1.LANGUAGE(+)= #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1

SELECT T.CONDSQL, T.SQLKEY, T.COLNAME,T.CONDSQLCNT,T.RETRIEVE_TABLE_NO, get_global_name(T.RETRIEVE_TABLE_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) AS TABLE_NAME FROM HR_RETRIEVE_STORED T WHERE T.HR_RETRIEVE_STORED_NO=#NO#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM HR_RETRIEVE_STORED T WHERE T.HR_RETRIEVE_STORED_NO=#NO#
sqlMap.select:
SELECT T.RETRIEVE_TABLE_NO as NO
FROM HR_RETRIEVE_STORED T WHERE T.HR_RETRIEVE_STORED_NO=#NO#

SELECT T.POST_NO CODE_NO, SY.CONTENT CODE_NAME, '0' PARENT_CODE_NO FROM HR_POST_GRADE T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY WHERE T.POST_NO = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT T.POST_NO CODE_NO, SY.CONTENT CODE_NAME, '0' PARENT_CODE_NO FROM HR_POST T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY WHERE T.POST_NO = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1
T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY T.ORDERNO

SELECT T.DUTY_NO CODE_NO, SY.CONTENT CODE_NAME, '0' PARENT_CODE_NO FROM HR_DUTY T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY WHERE T.DUTY_NO = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1
T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY T.ORDERNO

SELECT T.POSITION_NO CODE_NO, SY.CONTENT CODE_NAME, '0' PARENT_CODE_NO FROM HR_POSITION T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY WHERE T.POSITION_NO = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1
T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#

sql.isNotEmpty: EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO=HE.DEPTNO START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO# CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO )

sqlMap.select:
SELECT HE.EMPID, HE.PERSON_ID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HD.CONTENT DEPTNAME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE HE.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE = #language:VARCHAR# AND HE.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY HE.EMPID
SELECT COUNT(HE.EMPID), FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE HE.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE = #language:VARCHAR# AND HE.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
